# .github/go-test-rows.txt — the table tools/gotestrows cuts ci-fast's
# go-test-touched selection by (ci-fast.yml, `plan`'s rows step).
#
#   weight <package> <short seconds> <plain seconds>
#       the package's measured `go test` wall on a fleet runner, alone in its
#       job: `go test -v -count=1 -short` (a broad diff's run) and plain `go
#       test` (a touched package's run). Light packages are packed into rows
#       under a budget by these numbers; a package not named here weighs 10.
#   split <package> <top-level test regexp>
#       that package runs as one row per split line (-run the pattern) plus a
#       complement row that -skips them all, so every test runs exactly once
#       and a new test lands in the complement.
#
# MEASURED 2026-11-08 on the schema fleet runners, one package per job, runs
# 42492071587 and 42493376287 (ci-measure-gotest, never merged). The
# numbers include compiling the test binary on a warm build cache. Hosts
# differ by up to 3x (bench-7 runs slowest); the numbers are as measured,
# whichever host took the job. A row that goes past the two-minute cap is
# re-measured and re-split here: the weights only place packages, they never
# decide whether one runs.
